VI.description: Releases a device context obtained with user32 GetDC.vi\2C through user32.dll ReleaseDC (stdcall\2C called in any thread). hWnd must be the window that was passed to GetDC (0 for the screen). return value is 1 when the DC was released\2C 0 when it was not. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: The window passed to GetDC; 0 for the screen.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
